= Round-trip SVG corpus

This directory contains focused inputs for the SVG -> PostScript model -> SVG
fidelity contract. Each SVG has exactly one entry in `manifest.yml`; paths in
the manifest are relative to this directory. `family` groups related features
without changing the identity of an individual fixture.

== What each leg compares

`model`:: The PostScript program `Postsvg::Translation::PsRenderer` builds from
the SVG, against the program `Postscript::Source.parse` reads back from
`Postscript::Serializer` output for it. Both sides go through
`RoundTrip::Normalizer` (`spec/support/round_trip`): operators only, with their
operand values, floats rounded to the serializer's 4 decimals.
`RoundTrip::Harness` reports the records that differ.

`svg`:: The input SVG, against `Postsvg.to_svg(Postsvg.to_ps(svg))`, compared on
what is drawn: shape geometry, fill, stroke, stroke width, line cap and join,
transforms and text, through `RoundTrip::SvgSummary`.

Every fixture also has a pinned `<fixture>.ps.golden` with the PostScript
`to_ps` emits; regenerate them with `rake round_trip:regenerate_goldens`.

== Markers

An entry may mark an expected mismatch on the `model` leg, the `svg` leg, or
both. A leg with no marker is expected to match. A `known_gap` is a bug that
must have a follow-up fix card. A `non_goal` records intentional, permanent
flattening that the round trip does not promise to preserve. The value of
either marker is the reason for the exception.

`spec/postsvg/round_trip_contract_spec.rb` (model leg) and
`spec/postsvg/round_trip_svg_contract_spec.rb` (svg leg) run both markers as
strict pending examples: the expected mismatch must remain visible, and an
unexpected pass fails the suite so the marker can be removed.
`spec/postsvg/round_trip_manifest_spec.rb` checks that every fixture has exactly
one entry and parses. The contract and golden specs carry the `round_trip` tag
(`bundle exec rspec --tag round_trip`); all of them run in the normal suite.

[source,yaml]
----
- file: shapes/polyline.svg
  family: shapes
  svg:
    known_gap: The fill is lost; to_ps emits only a black stroke of the open path (task 53-10).

- file: gradient/linear.svg
  family: gradient
  svg:
    non_goal: url() paint is permanently flattened to a plain fill (black today).
----

== Native parser parity

Each manifest fixture also runs through `RoundTrip::Harness` with a callable
that explicitly selects `Postscript::Source.parse(source, engine: :native)`.
Its normalized program must match the Ruby parser's normalized program and
the emitted model. Model markers remain strict pending; SVG-only markers do
not weaken the model comparison.

Run only native examples with
`bundle exec rspec spec/postsvg/round_trip_contract_spec.rb --tag native`.
They also carry `round_trip` and run in the normal CI suite. Each example
skips with an explicit reason if native support is unavailable. A skip is
not evidence of native parity.

The installed postscript must include `Source::NativeEngine` (the released
0.2.1 gem predates that API). Upstream's optional engine also needs parsanol
>= 1.3.96, Ruby >= 3.2, its platform native extension, and the postscript
gem's `grammars/postscript.json` artifact. Add parsanol to the bundle when
running native checks; it is not a runtime dependency of postsvg. The
upstream availability probe reports missing/old parsanol or a missing native
extension. Other errors, including a broken grammar artifact or a corpus
parse failure, fail the spec rather than being converted into skips.
